learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to train your body like an athlete by understanding the different parts of motor fitness like speed, agility, and balance!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Speed is how fast you can run from one point to another. Agility is your superpower to change direction quickly without falling down, just like dodging a player in Kabaddi!
Balance keeps you steady on your feet, whether you are standing on one leg or riding a bicycle. Coordination is how well your eyes, hands, and feet work together to catch a flying ball.
Power is combining your strength and speed together in one quick movement. You use explosive power when you jump high to spike a volleyball or sprint off the starting block.
We use fun fitness tests like the 50-meter dash or the shuttle run to see how fast and agile we are. Tracking your scores helps you see how much stronger you get over time!

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Zig-Zag Agility Drill
fun_activity.instructions: Set up five water bottles in a line and time yourself running zig-zag through them as fast as you can without knocking any over!

quick_recap: ⭐ Motor fitness includes super skills like speed, agility, balance, coordination, and power that make you great at sports.
⭐ Practicing fun drills and measuring your fitness helps your brain and muscles work together like a perfect team.
